deed.leader: On that date {rank} {name} led a flight of {flight} {aircraft}s on the "{target}" mission near {place}.
deed.member: On that date {rank} {name} flew as a member of a flight of {flight} {aircraft}s on the "{target}" mission near {place}.
deed.air: In the engagement that followed he destroyed {air_list}.
deed.ground_flak: Pressing his attacks through intense anti-aircraft fire, he destroyed {ground_n} enemy vehicles, guns and installations.
deed.ground: He destroyed {ground_n} enemy vehicles, guns and installations.
deed.hits: His aircraft was struck {hits} times by enemy fire; he continued the mission and brought it back to base.
deed.bailed: With his aircraft damaged beyond control he was forced to bail out over hostile territory.
deed.lost: He did not return from this mission.
deed.period: During the period {period_from} to {period_to} {rank} {name} flew {missions} combat missions, {hours} hours over hostile territory, and destroyed {air_total} enemy aircraft and {ground_total} vehicles, guns and installations.
deed.period_air: During the period {period_from} to {period_to} {rank} {name} flew {missions} combat missions, {hours} hours over hostile territory, and destroyed {air_total} enemy aircraft.
deed.period_ground: During the period {period_from} to {period_to} {rank} {name} flew {missions} combat missions, {hours} hours over hostile territory, and destroyed {ground_total} enemy vehicles, guns and installations.
deed.period_plain: During the period {period_from} to {period_to} {rank} {name} flew {missions} combat missions, {hours} hours over hostile territory.
deed.unit_period: During the period {period_from} to {period_to} the squadron flew {sorties_unit} combat sorties and destroyed {air_total} enemy aircraft and {ground_total} vehicles, guns and installations, in the face of determined opposition.

moh: The President of the United States, in the name of Congress, takes pride in presenting the Medal of Honor to {rank} {name}, United States Air Force, for conspicuous gallantry and intrepidity at the risk of his life above and beyond the call of duty while serving as pilot of an {aircraft} with the {unit}, in action near {place}, Korea, on {date}.

By his gallantry and devotion to duty {rank} {name} upheld the highest traditions of the military service and reflected great credit upon himself, the Far East Air Forces and the United States Air Force.
dsc: The President of the United States takes pleasure in presenting the Distinguished Service Cross to {rank} {name}, United States Air Force, for extraordinary heroism in connection with military operations against an armed enemy of the United Nations while serving as pilot of an {aircraft} with the {unit}, in action near {place}, Korea, on {date}.
The extraordinary heroism displayed by {rank} {name} reflects great credit upon himself, the Far East Air Forces and the United States Air Force.
silver_star: The President of the United States takes pleasure in presenting the Silver Star to {rank} {name}, United States Air Force, for gallantry in action against an enemy of the United Nations while serving as pilot of an {aircraft} with the {unit}, in action near {place}, Korea, on {date}.
The gallantry displayed by {rank} {name} reflects great credit upon himself, the Far East Air Forces and the United States Air Force.
dfc: The President of the United States takes pleasure in presenting the Distinguished Flying Cross to {rank} {name}, United States Air Force, for extraordinary achievement while participating in aerial flight as pilot of an {aircraft} with the {unit}, in action near {place}, Korea, on {date}.
The skill and courage displayed by {rank} {name} reflect great credit upon himself, the Far East Air Forces and the United States Air Force.
bsm_v: The President of the United States takes pleasure in presenting the Bronze Star Medal with "V" device to {rank} {name}, United States Air Force, for heroism in connection with military operations against an armed enemy while serving as pilot of an {aircraft} with the {unit}, in action near {place}, Korea, on {date}.
The heroism displayed by {rank} {name} reflects great credit upon himself and the United States Air Force.
bsm: The President of the United States takes pleasure in presenting the Bronze Star Medal to {rank} {name}, United States Air Force, for meritorious service in connection with military operations against an armed enemy while serving with the {unit} in Korea.
The meritorious service of {rank} {name} reflects great credit upon himself and the United States Air Force.
air_medal: The President of the United States takes pleasure in presenting the Air Medal to {rank} {name}, United States Air Force, for meritorious achievement while participating in aerial flight as pilot of an {aircraft} with the {unit} in Korea.
The professional skill and airmanship displayed by {rank} {name} reflect great credit upon himself, the Far East Air Forces and the United States Air Force.
commendation: {rank} {name}, United States Air Force, is awarded the Commendation Ribbon with Metal Pendant for meritorious service as pilot of an {aircraft} with the {unit} in Korea.
His devotion to duty reflects credit upon himself and the United States Air Force.
purple_heart: {rank} {name}, United States Air Force, is awarded the Purple Heart for wounds received in action against an enemy of the United Nations near {place}, Korea, on {date}, while serving as pilot of an {aircraft} with the {unit}.
lom: The President of the United States takes pleasure in presenting the Legion of Merit to {rank} {name}, United States Air Force, for exceptionally meritorious conduct in the performance of outstanding service as commanding officer of the {unit} in Korea.
The leadership and devotion to duty of {rank} {name} reflect great credit upon himself, the Far East Air Forces and the United States Air Force.
dsm: The President of the United States takes pleasure in presenting the Distinguished Service Medal to {rank} {name}, United States Air Force, for exceptionally meritorious service in a duty of great responsibility as commander of the {unit} in Korea.
The distinguished service of {rank} {name} reflects great credit upon himself and the United States Air Force.
duc: The {unit} is cited for extraordinary heroism in action against an armed enemy of the United Nations in Korea. {deed}
The gallantry, determination and esprit de corps displayed by the members of the squadron reflect great credit upon themselves, the Far East Air Forces and the United States Air Force.
rok_puc: The President of the Republic of Korea cites the {unit}, United States Air Force, for exceptionally meritorious service and heroism in the defence of the Republic of Korea. {deed}
The squadron's achievements reflect great credit upon its members and upon the United States Air Force, and have earned the gratitude of the Korean people.
ndsm: The National Defense Service Medal is awarded to {rank} {name} for honorable active service in the armed forces of the United States during the Korean emergency.
ksm: The Korean Service Medal is awarded to {rank} {name} for service in the Korean theatre with the {unit} during the period {period_from} to {period_to}.
un: The United Nations Service Medal is awarded to {rank} {name} for service in Korea with the {unit} under the flag of the United Nations.

hero: By decree of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of the USSR of {date}, for the exemplary performance of combat missions and for the courage and heroism shown in them, {rank} {name} is awarded the title of Hero of the Soviet Union with the Order of Lenin and the Gold Star medal.
lenin: By decree of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of the USSR of {date}, for the exemplary performance of combat missions of the command and for the valour and courage shown in them, {rank} {name} is awarded the Order of Lenin.
red_banner: By decree of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of the USSR of {date}, for the exemplary performance of combat missions of the command and for the valour and courage shown in them, {rank} {name} is awarded the Order of the Red Banner{order}.
suvorov: By decree of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of the USSR of {date}, for skilful leadership in combat and the successes achieved, {rank} {name} is awarded the Order of Suvorov, 3rd class.
nevsky: By decree of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of the USSR of {date}, for initiative and courage in command and for the successful actions of his unit, {rank} {name} is awarded the Order of Alexander Nevsky.
red_star: By decree of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of the USSR of {date}, for the exemplary performance of combat missions and for the courage shown in them, {rank} {name} is awarded the Order of the Red Star.
courage: By order of {date}, for the courage and bravery shown in combat with the enemy, {rank} {name} is awarded the medal For Courage.
battle_merit: By order of {date}, for skilful and determined action in the performance of combat missions, {rank} {name} is awarded the medal For Battle Merit.

hero_k: By decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of {date}, for exceptional heroism in the Fatherland Liberation War, {rank} {name} is awarded the title Hero of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea with the Gold Star medal and the Order of the National Flag.
freedom: By decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of {date}, for distinguished service in combat, {rank} {name} is awarded the Order of Freedom and Independence.
soldiers_honour: By decree of the Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of {date}, for bravery in combat against the enemy, {rank} {name} is awarded the Order of Soldier's Honour.
merit_k: By order of {date}, for merit in combat, {rank} {name} is awarded the Military Merit Medal.
flw: {rank} {name} is awarded the medal for the Fatherland Liberation War 1950-1953 for service in the war with the {unit}.

merit_c: By order of the Chinese People's Volunteers of {date}, for merit in combat, {name} is awarded the Military Merit Medal.
liberation_c: {name} is awarded the commemorative medal for the Liberation of North China for service in the campaign.
oppose_c: {name} is awarded the commemorative medal Oppose America, Aid Korea for service with the Chinese People's Volunteers in Korea.
